common.tagline: No one should have to go alone.

welcome.title: Someone nearby can be there.
welcome.line1: Teman connects people who need someone beside them with neighbours who have a few hours to give. Always free.

join.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS.
join.otpHint: From the SMS we just sent. It works for 10 minutes.
join.otpWrong: That code doesn't match. Check the SMS and try again — your typing is kept.
join.otpExpired: That code has expired. We can send a new one.
join.resendWait: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} seconds
join.areaHint: Just the area — never your address.

home.needTemanSub: For you or someone you care for
home.availableSub: Tell your area when you're free
home.goingSub: Someone may be heading there too
home.aroundNeed: {count, plural, one {# person needs a Teman} other {# people need a Teman}}
home.aroundFree: {count, plural, one {# Teman free this afternoon} other {# Temans free this afternoon}}

language.hint: Every language is always shown in its own writing, so you can find yours without reading this sentence.
